what: Broadcom has two large businesses: chips for networking, connectivity and AI (including custom AI chips for Google and Meta), and enterprise software, above all VMware, acquired in 2023.
customers: Google, Meta, Apple, cloud providers, telecom operators and large enterprises (VMware).
money: networking and switch chips, custom AI accelerators (ASICs), iPhone wireless chips
VMware, security and mainframe software on subscription
moat: Leadership in networking chips and custom chip design, and software that sits at the heart of corporate data centers and is hard to replace.
risks: Concentration on a few large AI customers
Large debt from the VMware deal
VMware customers unhappy with price increases
